title: He Leadeth Me
lyrics: [C]He leadeth me, O [F]blessed thought! O [C]words with heavenly comfort [G]fraught!
[C]Whate'er I do, where[F]'er I be Still [C]'tis God's hand that [G]leadeth [C]me.
His [C]faithful [G]follower [C]I would be, [F]For [C]by His [Am]hand He [C]leadeth me.
[C]Sometimes mid scenes of [F]deepest gloom, [C]sometimes where Eden's bowers [G]bloom,
by [C]waters still, o'er [F]troubled sea, still [C]'tis his hand that [G]leadeth [C]me.
[C]Lord, I would place my [F]hand in thine, nor [C]ever murmur nor [G]repine;
[C]content, whatever [F]lot I see, since [C]'tis my God that [G]leadeth [C]me.
[C]And when my task on [F]earth is done, when [C]by thy grace the victory's [G]won,
e'en [C]death's cold wave I [F]will not flee, since [C]God through Jordan [G]leadeth [C]me.
